sample_unit: oncology informed consent forms (each translated by 4 methods, scored by 2 physicians)

links.outcome: Language equivalence of AI-translated oncology consent forms versus certified Spanish translations, rated on 5-point scale
links.effect: Certified 4.99; ChatGPT-4o 4.89; DeepL Pro 4.43 (P<0.001 vs certified); Med_English2Spanish 3.32 (P<0.001). Variable equivalence; not suitable for clinical deployment without human review.
links.quote: While AI-generated translations are currently not suitable for clinical deployment without human review, this exploratory study supports further analysis of AI translation tools for reducing language barriers to LEP population enrollment.

unlisted_practices: Using certified human translation as reference standard to evaluate AI translation of informed consent forms
Bilingual physician evaluation of AI translations across semantic, idiomatic, experiential, conceptual, and safety domains

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and safety of AI translation tools (ChatGPT-4o, DeepL, Med_English2Spanish) for oncology informed consent forms compared to certified translations using expert physician review, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
